text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, March 4, 2024, Appeal DDRT2024-07.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, and directed that the conditions of the Order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Antonio Jarquin Corona and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before October 25, 2024.
